Batch scrape of multiple URLs all succeeding

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { batchScrape, createEngine } from "@xberg-io/crawlberg";
async function main() {
  const engine = createEngine(null);
  const urls = ["https://example.com/page1", "https://example.com/page2", "https://example.com/page3"];
  const result = await batchScrape(engine, urls);
  console.log(result.completedCount);
  console.log(result.failedCount);
  console.log(result.totalCount);
}

void main();
```
